subject: Compliance add-on fee split, onboarding timeline & PO path
messages:
From: Carolyn Kim <c.kim@medsync.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance add-on pricing — breakdown & onboarding timing

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the KV cache demo. Procurement asked me to get a clear line-item breakdown for the compliance add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, data residency) and a realistic onboarding timeline so they can scope internal approvals. Two asks:

1) A PDF/csv that shows the list price plus our recommended concession (if any) across three purchase styles: monthly usage, committed throughput, and seat-based KMS.
2) An onboarding plan with milestones and an estimate for when audit-log retention and residency would be live in our EU region.

We need to submit a business case to finance by Sep 28 — can you get something over by Sep 18? Attaching the initial security questionnaire in case it helps.

Thanks,
Carolyn Kim
Product Ops — MedSync Health
carolyn.kim@medsync.com

Attachment: medsync_security_q2.pdf (pdf)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Carolyn Kim <c.kim@medsync.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing — breakdown & onboarding timing

Carolyn — thanks for the clear asks. I sent a quick pricing grid and a draft onboarding SOW (see attachments). High level notes up-front:

- We recommend a blended approach for MedSync given predictable nightly ingest and some bursty API patterns: commit to a monthly audit-log throughput tier + a small KMS seat allocation for dedicated HSM keys.
- Typical concession for comparable deals is an onboarding credit amortized over 12 months (we can structure it as either a one-time credit or a monthly amortization).
- EU residency: if you pick the EU region deployment we can target 6–8 weeks to enable audit-log retention + region-specific KMS; HSM provisioning is typically on the 8–10 week path depending on capacity.

Attached: compliance_pricing_grid.xlsx (xls), onboarding_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf).

Quick question for procurement: do you need line items split by CapEx (one-time SOW fees) vs Opex (recurring add-on) for the PO? Laura — can you chime on the typical wording we include for amortized onboarding credits?

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
N: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: compliance_pricing_grid.xlsx (xlsx), onboarding_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Carolyn Kim <c.kim@medsync.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsync.com
Date: 2026-09-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing — breakdown & onboarding timing

Thanks Nikhil — opening a few clarifying points from procurement:

- They prefer as much Opex as possible (recurring monthly) to avoid capital approvals this quarter. If onboarding work can be pushed into a monthly professional-services line that would help.
- They want the KMS/HSM pricing expressed as: (a) per-seat provisioning fee, and (b) monthly management fee. Can you split those?
- For residency, can you confirm whether audit logs can be retained in EU only (not replicated to US) and what the export controls look like?

Also copying our vendor lead (procurement@medsync.com) — procurement asked whether Redwood can provide a sample PO line and whether an invoice schedule with a 30% upfront is acceptable.

Carolyn

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Carolyn Kim <c.kim@medsync.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing — breakdown & onboarding timing

Carolyn / procurement team — we reviewed internally and here is a concrete counterproposal that aligns with your Opex preference and short approval window:

1) Pricing structure (monthly recurring emphasis):
   - Audit-log retention tier: $1,200 / month (up to 2 TB month-over-month), overage $0.60/GB.
   - KMS/HSM: one-time provisioning fee $9,000 (covers HSM key slot & attestation) + $450 / month management fee (HSM patching, key rotation).
   - Data residency surcharge for EU region: $0.25 / 1k tokens processed or $350 / month minimum (applies only if EU-only retention selected).

2) Onboarding credit and PO structure:
   - We can amortize a $18,000 onboarding credit over 12 months as a monthly credit of $1,500, applied against the recurring invoice. This keeps the customer Opex-heavy and reduces initial CapEx.
   - If you need a PO with upfront line, we usually accept 30% upfront on the one-time provisioning fees; recurring is invoiced monthly thereafter.

3) Residency/export controls:
   - Yes — audit logs can be stored EU-only (we will disable replication to US). Export can only be performed via authenticated job and is logged; we can provide the export audit chain for compliance.

Next steps I propose: Laura will convert this into a sample PO wording and a one-page invoice schedule; if that works we can update the SOW and ship a version for signatures by Sep 28.

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), pricing_summary.csv (csv)

From: Carolyn Kim <c.kim@medsync.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medsync.com
Date: 2026-09-25T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing — breakdown & onboarding timing

Nikhil — this is helpful, thanks. Procurement approved in-principle for the monthly-forward structure and the amortized onboarding credit. Two quick items before we take the SOW to legal:

1) Procurement will issue a PO but they want confirmation in writing that the $18,000 credit is applied only to professional services/onboarding and cannot be used against overage charges. Please confirm.
2) They asked whether Redwood can accept invoices on Net 45 for the first two months while finance ramps up. Is Net 45 acceptable for recurring invoices?

If you can confirm those two points we’ll move to internal signatures and circulate the PO.

Carolyn Kim
Product Ops — MedSync Health
